title: Integrate ActivityFeed into AppHeader; sync roadmap metrics with implementation status
body:
ActivityFeed component existed but was never wired into the console UI. Section 11 (Success Metrics) of `ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md` was stale and contradicted the Phase descriptions in Section 4.

### Code change

- **`AppHeader.tsx`**: Replace the non-functional dummy `Bell` button with the actual `ActivityFeed` component, which provides a Sheet sidebar for recent activity items

```tsx
// Before: static icon, no behavior
<Button variant="ghost" size="icon"><Bell className="h-4 w-4" /></Button>

// After: fully functional activity feed
<ActivityFeed />
```

### Documentation

- **`ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md`** Section 11: Mark verified L1 items as complete across Phases 1-3, 15, 16, 17, 18 — aligning metrics checkboxes with the already-correct Phase descriptions in Section 4
